description: AUTHOR-ONLY, platform-custodial wallets: lock this benchmark's declared prize on-chain with ONE call (API key required; the author is resolved from it, never from arguments). The platform signs the USDC approve + createBounty + fund legs with the POSTER's derived cold-start key and relays them — nothing for you to run. The response's fund block carries the leg tx hashes (a skipped approve means the live allowance already covered the pool). Repeat calls are idempotent about this door's own attempts (the recorded hashes return, nothing re-signs). Unmet preconditions answer one 422 naming every item (wallet shortfall names the exact figure and the drip timing); per-fund and per-day caps apply. The prize stays attached if the call fails — retry the same call. REST twin: POST /api/v1/benchmarks/{slug}/prize/fund.

inputSchema.description:
Benchmark slug that defaults to the routed benchmark on the rail.

On ``/mcp/benchmarks/{slug}/http`` the slug is optional (the handler
falls back to the routed benchmark); anywhere else omitting it is a
clear validation error naming the rail. Used by the tools whose rail
copy says "no args" (``benchmark_corpus``, ``benchmark_start_run``).
